ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the graph represents the inverse proportion function $y=\frac{k}{x}$ in the second quadrant. If the area of the rectangle $OABC$ in the graph is $4$, what is the value of $k$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given the inverse proportion function $y=\frac{k}{x}$, and the area of rectangle OABC is 4,\\
$\therefore |k|=4$, which means $k=\pm 4$,\\
Since the graph of the inverse proportion function $y=\frac{k}{x}$ is in the second quadrant, $k<0$,\\
$\therefore k=\boxed{-4}$.

Read from the text that the curve is y=k/x and the rectangle area is 4. Use the standard property for y=k/x: for any point (x,y) on the curve, the axis-aligned rectangle formed with the coordinate axes has area |xy|=|k|.
